legal_update_text: The Terms of Use or the Privacy Policy changed since your last acceptance. Read the new versions and confirm to keep using your account.
legal_update_accept: I have read and accept the current versions
legal_review_notice: This text is a technical template describing how the system handles data. Before operating with real customers, have it reviewed by a lawyer and fill in the controller details.
legal_controller_unset: The controller details (company name, tax ID and data protection contact) have not been configured in this installation yet.
cookie_banner_text: We use essential cookies to make the site work (sign-in, language and this choice). Analytics and marketing cookies are only turned on if you allow them, and you can change your mind at any time.
cookie_banner_policy: Learn more in the Cookie Policy
cookie_necessary_text: They keep you signed in, remember your language and store this choice. The site does not work without them, so they do not depend on consent.
cookie_analytics_text: They help us understand how the site is used, in aggregate, so we can improve it. The site uses none today; if it ever does, it will only load after your consent.
cookie_marketing_text: They are used to show ads and measure campaigns. The site uses none today; if it ever does, it will only load after your consent.
cookie_gpc_notice: Your browser sent the Global Privacy Control signal. We treat it as a refusal of analytics and marketing.
privacy_export_text: A copy of your account data, all your orders, your acceptances of the terms and the cookie consents linked to your account, as JSON. It does not include your password or sessions.
privacy_delete_text: Your name, email and access are removed and this cannot be undone. Orders are kept with no link to you (tax and financial obligations) and the delivery address is erased. You cannot delete the account while an order is in progress.
privacy_deleted_text: Your personal data was anonymized and you were signed out. Past orders are kept with no link to you, due to tax and financial obligations.
privacy_error_generic: We could not complete this. Please try again.
privacy_error_offline: We could not reach the server. Please try again.
privacy_error_reauth: For your security, sign in again and try right after.
privacy_error_open_orders: There are orders in progress. Complete or cancel them before deleting the account.
privacy_error_role: Only customer accounts can be deleted here. Please contact the administrator.
privacy_error_rate: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
